Mixed macro: mega-caps show diverging IV (TSLA 56% vs COST 23%). [[pos:Earnings resilience]] in GOOG/AMZN/MSFT supports put selling below support. [[neg:Valuation extremes]] in TSLA/COST warrant caution. Top setups: [[key:GOOG $250 put]] (23d, undervalued, +110% EPS) and [[key:AMZN $260 call]] (7d, at resistance, EPS +107%). [[warn:Fed/China risks]] could spike vol broadly.

Market shows mixed IV extremes: [[key:AMD 156.5% IV]] dominates premium but [[warn:assignment risk]], while [[key:VOO 26% IV]] offers stability. Top setups: [[pos:TSM Sell Put $370/Call $445 23d]] for balanced premium, and [[pos:NVDA Sell Put $190/Call $220 7d]] capturing high theta decay. [[neg:AAPL/INTC negative momentum]] warrants caution.

Overall market shows mixed IV regimes: UNH (39.3%) and ISRG (37.8%) offer moderate premium, while MRVL (97.5%) and SPCX (70.9%) present elevated vol. [[key:MRVL extreme IV]] drives rich put premiums but signals event risk. AVGO (57.0%) and EWT (47.7%) sit mid-range. Top setups: [[pos:UNH near-fair valuation with strong analyst support]] and [[pos:AVGO high growth despite overvalued flag]]. [[warn:SPCX high IV with narrow range]] and [[warn:EWT long-dated expiry]] require caution. [[key:ISRG call resistance below spot]] limits upside call selling.
